name: Security-rule lint in verify
summary: An advisory verify finding (EP-SECURITY-RULE-UNENFORCED) for a prose security rule that no setting, permission rule or sandbox option enforces, since such rules give false assurance. On in v8.0 as a Trial (engine); its kill test is an owner review, not a bench run. Costs verify time only.

evidence.source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23550 (When "Do Not" Is Not Deny: Security Rules in CLAUDE.md vs Built-In Controls)
evidence.setting: The ledger calls it E1-adjacent: it measures how often prose security rules are enforced, not whether this lint helps
evidence.effect: Only 4 to 16% of prose security rules had an enforcement control (the 16% is in the abstract)

killTest.pass: On 20 configurations reviewed with their owners: at least one actionable finding per 5 configurations and at most 30% false positives
killTest.scheduled: v8.0, where the check ships on as an advisory finding: an owner review of 20 configurations, not a maintainer bench run; the ledger sets no date

maintenance: Owned engine check, maintained with the engine.
